resolutions.researcher_notes: Pipeline II = the NEW 125-km line + 3 compressor stations that Iranian companies agreed on 3 July 2024 (Ashgabat) to build to raise Turkmen gas deliveries to Iran along the Dovletabad-Serakhs-Khangeran route. As of the announcement it is to-be-built / future construction, i.e. 'proposed' — consistent with the sheet value. Widely reported by independent outlets (News Central Asia regional desk, RFE/RL, World-Energy); replaces the dead mfa.gov.tm/news/4626 seed. All three verified 200 + content present.

Both sources describe it explicitly as a natural-gas pipeline supplying gas from Turkmenistan to Iran (and onward swap to Iraq). Fuel = Gas fully supported. Two independent outlets. Replaces dead neftegaz.ru seed.

No source uses the literal word 'transmission' (contains_value=false). PipelineType=transmission is a GEM schema classification, and it is consistent with the described asset: a long-distance (125-km) cross-border gas trunk line moving bulk export volumes, not a distribution/gathering line. Sources support the physical description that underpins the classification; verify the schema tag rather than expecting the word verbatim.

CONTRADICTION/DERIVED VALUE FLAG: no source states 19.5 bcm/y directly (contains_value=false). The sheet's 19.50 bcm/y is a GEM derivation: planned total deliveries to Iran = 40 bcm/y, minus existing Pipeline I (12.5 bcm/y) and Korpeje-Kordkuy via Chalyouk metering station (8 bcm/y) = 40 - 20.5 = 19.5 bcm/y as the incremental Pipeline II capacity. nCa source verified to contain the 12.5, 8 and 40 figures; World-Energy contains the 40. Note the 12.5/8/40 numbers all trace to the single 3 July 2024 Turkmen MFA press release (so independent=false), and no source attributes 19.5 to this new line specifically — flag for human review whether 19.5 should stand as computed.

Both sources name the supply corridor 'Dovletabad - Serakhs - Khangeran' (= Dauletabad-Sarakhs-Khangiran). nCa verified to contain both 'Dovletabad' and 'Khangeran'. Supports StartLocation=Dauletabad (Ahal Province, Turkmenistan) and EndLocation=Khangiran (Razavi Khorasan Province, Iran); the new 125-km line and compressor stations sit on the Turkmen side feeding this route. Endpoint city/route names corroborated by two independent outlets. Fills the previously-blank Location [ref].
